newsitem.title: IRAN: Iran says S.Korea to buy $300 mln in petrochemicals.
newsitem.headline: Iran says S.Korea to buy $300 mln in petrochemicals.

text.p: Iranian Oil Minister Gholamreza Aghazadeh said on Tuesday South Korea had agreed to buy $300 million in petrochemicals from Iran, the official Iranian news agency IRNA said.

"In light of the high quality and diversity of Iranian petrochemical products on the world market especially on the Far East market, the South Korean officials signed an agreement to buy $300 million worth of petrochemicals from Iran," Aghazadeh told the agency. He gave no further details.

Aghazadeh, speaking after returning from a trip to South Korea and China, also said the National Iranian Oil Company (NIOC) had held negotiations with a Chinese offshore oil company on developing Iran's Salman Khuff gas field in the Gulf.
A chinese delegation was expected to visit Iran soon to study the project, he added.
